استضعفا (form X)
# اِسْتَضْعَفَا (istaḍʕafā) /is.tadˤ.ʕa.faː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَضْعَفَ (istaḍʕafa)
# اُسْتُضْعِفَا (ustuḍʕifā) /us.tudˤ.ʕi.faː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَضْعَفَ (istaḍʕafa)
# اِسْتَضْعِفَا (istaḍʕifā) /is.tadˤ.ʕi.faː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَضْعَفَ (istaḍʕafa)
